title: How do you want to import your taxes from last year?
text: How do you want to import your taxes from last year? I used H&R Block software or Turbo Tax software and have my data file. (recommended) Giving us your data file is the fastest, most accurate way to import your info. If you used H&R Block software, search for a file ending with the extension .T24 If you used TurboTax, the file we need ends in .tax2024 I have a PDF copy of my 2024 return.
